baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future causative سأصليه, with the object pronoun -ه and the named accusative سقر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker takes agency over the object's movement or exposure and causes him to meet and endure the heat denoted by the focus root's convergent fire branches.

activation_trace.role: Encountering fire and its heat supplies the literal exposure and makes the causative an imposed encounter rather than mere proximity.
The non-dominant mapped root independently converges on meeting and enduring fire, strengthening the direct heat reading.

changed_reading.before: I will put him in Saqar.
changed_reading.after: I will actively bring him into sustained contact with Saqar's fire and heat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb سأصليه anchored in the focus root's fire-use branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Kindling, roasting, and straightening by heat make Saqar not only a destination but an operative process applied to the object.

activation_trace.role: Fire used to kindle, roast, or straighten supplies a material-working image in which Saqar acts on and alters him.

changed_reading.before: Saqar is the place into which he is sent.
changed_reading.after: Saqar is also the heat operation to which he is deliberately subjected.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb's split ص ل ي inventory contains worship and mercy branches alongside fire exposure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root field places binding worship, blessing, and mercy in polarity with the actual causative fire sense, allowing the threat to carry an anti-blessing or failed-worship resonance without replacing its literal heat sense.

activation_trace.role: Binding ritual worship supplies the positive pole against which the imposed fire encounter can later be heard as a reversal.
Supplication, praise, and mercy supply a beneficent pole whose absence makes the causative fire branch sound privative.

changed_reading.before: The verb denotes only imposed burning.
changed_reading.after: The imposed burning remains literal but sits inside a root-field polarity with worship, blessing, and mercy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object-taking causative سأصليه read through the focus inventory's trap branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: A set snare turns the named destination into a capture apparatus: the speaker causes the object to be caught in Saqar rather than merely transported there.

activation_trace.role: Snares and traps supply a capture image that assigns Saqar the function of holding what is caused into it.
The second mapped root's set-snare branch preserves the capture reading across the split mapping.

changed_reading.before: He is sent to a punitive place.
changed_reading.after: He is caused into a punitive capture that closes around and holds him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated greatness root forms a status circuit around the focus: greatness is first directed to the Lord, then seized by the man as pride, and finally predicated of Saqar as one of the great warnings. The focus causative becomes the act that reverses self-magnification and places the self-exalting object under the truly great sign.

activation_trace.role: Imposed encounter with fire supplies the event that enforces the reversal in rank.
Magnifying a thing inwardly supplies the proper upward valuation directed to the Lord.
Greatness as pride supplies the man's rival act of self-exaltation immediately before the threat.
The major or weightiest matter supplies Saqar's post-focus classification among the great warnings.

structural_cues: The same root occurs as an opening command, the target's pre-focus posture, and Saqar's post-focus classification.
The focus threat stands between the pride occurrence and the declaration that Saqar is one of the great matters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the three greatness positions and the intervening causative threat; I infer a status-reversal arrow from self-exaltation to subjection under the great warning. A live alternative is that the repetitions characterize separate matters without forming one reversal.

changed_reading.before: The sentence announces generic punishment for rejection.
changed_reading.after: The sentence enforces a reversal of greatness: the self-exalting man is subjected to one of the truly great warnings under the Lord he refused to magnify.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier threat سأرهقه صعودا shares the first-person future, object pronoun, and accusative complement pattern with سأصليه سقر. Its overpowering burden and steep ascent supply a processual manner for the later fire encounter: coercive, effortful, and sustained.

activation_trace.role: Encountering and enduring heat supplies the later imposed ordeal whose manner is sharpened by the parallel threat.
Imposing a burdensome task supplies coercion and weight to the shared future causative pattern.
A steep obstacle and hardship supply an extended trajectory rather than an instantaneous placement.

structural_cues: 74:17 and 74:26 repeat a first-person future verb plus -ه plus a named ordeal.
The man's deliberative sequence lies between the two threats, delaying but not cancelling the parallel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the syntactic parallel and branches of imposed burden and steep hardship; I infer that the earlier clause lends process and manner to the later one. The alternative is that the two threats name distinct punishments with no transferred manner.

changed_reading.before: I will make him enter Saqar in a single transition.
changed_reading.after: I will impose Saqar on him as an overpowering, arduous course of fire exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate aftermath denies both preservation and release, then describes heat leaving a visible effect on the human surface. These clauses turn the focus's fire-working branch into exhaustive material action: Saqar keeps applying heat until no unaffected remainder is spared.

activation_trace.role: Roasting and straightening by fire supply the active material process whose extent the next clauses specify.
Continuance and remainder, under negation, supply the claim that no unaffected residue persists.
Leaving a thing, also negated, supplies the refusal to release or spare the object from the process.
Heat that changes color supplies the visible material result of the fire exposure.
The exposed skin or surface supplies the locus on which the heat's alteration becomes legible.

structural_cues: 74:28 uses a balanced double negation immediately after the naming question about Saqar.
74:29 follows the no-remainder pair with a heat-effect predicate and the polyvalent البشر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated remainder, negated leaving, heat alteration, and a surface branch; I infer that these are result clauses for the focus causative. البشر may instead mean humanity collectively, which preserves broad exposure but weakens the specifically dermal rendering.

changed_reading.before: He is brought into contact with fire.
changed_reading.after: He is subjected to an exhaustive heat operation that neither releases nor leaves an unchanged remainder and writes its effect on the exposed surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fire-working image is recast as an assay: the numbered fire apparatus tests people as heat tests material, producing certainty in some, exposing diseased doubt in others, and functioning as reminder. The target suffers the focus action while the same disclosed apparatus acts epistemically on observers.

activation_trace.role: Fire used to work and alter material supplies the physical side of an assay mechanism.
Testing metal and people supplies the assay relation that transfers fire from punishment alone to disclosure.
Burning and blackening by fire makes the test materially continuous with the focus heat rather than merely thematic.
Settled knowledge after doubt supplies one observable outcome of the assay for receptive readers.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the warning function of the disclosed fire apparatus.

structural_cues: 74:31 makes the number produce opposed epistemic outcomes: certainty and increase on one side, questioning and misguidance on the other.
The long explanatory ayah closes by naming the referent a reminder for humanity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fire-adjacent assay branch, the epistemic split, and reminder language; I infer that Saqar's disclosure participates in the test. A live alternative is that only the number nineteen is the test, leaving the focus action purely punitive.

changed_reading.before: The causative fire action affects only its direct object.
changed_reading.after: The direct object is punished, while the disclosed machinery of that punishment also assays and warns everyone who encounters its description.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's racer-following branch becomes active inside a post-focus sequence where night moves behind, dawn uncovers, and humans may advance or delay. Saqar can therefore be imagined as the terminal ordering that makes the delayer follow behind rather than as an unstructured transfer.

activation_trace.role: The racer immediately following the leader supplies an ordered-procession image for the otherwise distant focus branch.
The passing rear or end of a thing supplies the cosmic movement into a behind-position.
Removing a covering supplies the dawn transition that makes the ordering visible.
Advancing forward and taking precedence supplies the leading position in the sequence.
Delaying to a later position supplies the lagging alternative that activates the follower branch.

structural_cues: The oath sequence moves from receding night to unveiling dawn before presenting advance or delay as alternatives.
The focus root's follower branch is explicitly race-like, while 74:37 encodes relative order rather than mere location.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a follower-in-race branch and a sequence of behind, unveiling, advance, and delay; I infer a processional arrow ending at Saqar for the delayer. The alternative is that the follower branch is lexical residue with no bearing on the fire verb.

changed_reading.before: The object is simply transferred into Saqar.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he is assigned the lagging follower's place in an ordered course whose disclosed endpoint is Saqar.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earning creates the liability, the self is held as its pledge, and the later question describes entry into Saqar as insertion along a path. Together these roots convert the baseline snare image into a causal capture: deeds thread the liable self into the holding apparatus named in the focus.

activation_trace.role: The set snare supplies the capture apparatus that can hold the object once his path reaches Saqar.
Seeking and acquiring a gain supplies the self-produced acts that generate liability.
A document or pledge held against a right supplies the legal mechanism by which the self is retained.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the path-to-container motion by which the captured self enters Saqar.

structural_cues: The universal pledge statement precedes the direct question asking what inserted the speakers into Saqar.
The answer is a first-person plural inventory of practices, making the path socially voiced rather than hidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition, collateral retention, and insertion; I infer the arrow earned acts -> liability -> held self -> entry into Saqar. Alternatives remain: رهينة may be accountability without trap imagery, and سلك may denote ordinary entry without threading.

changed_reading.before: The divine subject unilaterally casts the object into a place.
changed_reading.after: Divine causation executes an earned capture path: acquired acts collateralize the self and thread it into Saqar's hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first answer to what inserted the speakers into Saqar is that they were not among the prayer-doers. Because the packet resolves the focus fire root and the context prayer root into the same two mapped inventories, the focus becomes a sharp root-field inversion: failure to join binding worship answers with being made to meet fire.

activation_trace.role: Encountering fire supplies the literal punitive pole of the inversion.
Prescribed worship in the focus root's non-dominant mapping makes the positive pole available before context activates it.
Prescribed worship supplies the confessed missing practice that directly answers the Saqar-entry question.
Binding ritual prayer independently converges across the split mapping and makes the prayer/fire opposition structurally robust.

structural_cues: 74:42 names Saqar in a direct question, and 74:43 begins the answer with absence from the prayer-doers.
The packet's split mappings cross-resolve both focus ص ل ي and context ص ل و to root_000879 and root_000880.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the direct question-answer sequence and the cross-resolved split inventories; I infer a deliberate root-field inversion from omitted prayer to imposed fire. The alternative is ordinary causal sequencing plus accidental phonological proximity, with no wordplay intended.

changed_reading.before: I will make him encounter fire, with worship senses irrelevant to the clause.
changed_reading.after: I will make him encounter fire becomes the negative answer-image to not having joined those bound to prayer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's final predication assigns the same divine speaker fitness for protective fear and forgiveness. This does not cancel the focus future, but bounds it as a targeted judgment within an agency that can also ward off harm and cover sin's consequence.

activation_trace.role: Mercy and blessing within the focus root field supply the latent beneficent pole reopened by the surah's ending.
Fitness and proper entitlement supply the closing claim that protection and forgiveness belong appropriately to the divine subject.
Warding off harm by protection supplies an outcome opposite to imposed exposure.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer from its effect supplies the explicit alternative to the focus judgment.

structural_cues: The final ayah follows repeated human and divine willing with a doubled أهل predication.
The closing protective and forgiving predicates belong to the same divine agent who speaks the focus future.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the common divine agent and the closing protection-forgiveness pair; I infer that the ending limits the focus sentence's scope to its specified object rather than defining the speaker only by punishment. The alternative is that the ending addresses other hearers and does not qualify this target's announced outcome.

changed_reading.before: The focus presents unqualified punitive agency.
changed_reading.after: The focus presents a specific, promised judgment by an agent whose whole-surah profile also includes protection and forgiveness; the threat remains intact but is not exhaustive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from a water-entry image to fire exposure. It remains anchored in the focus fire branch and in the confession's doubled wading root, which combines literal immersion with entering discourse. Downstream prose should present it as a social-medium analogy, not claim that the context verb lexically means entering fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imposed fire encounter in سأصليه, contrasted with the speakers' self-described collective wading.

activation_trace.role: Meeting fire and its heat supplies the terminal medium into which the focus object is caused.
Entering water supplies the embodied immersion image that makes prior voluntary participation feel medium-like.
Entering discourse or an affair supplies the social mechanism by which the group immersed itself before the imposed fire encounter.

changed_reading.before: The focus object is individually forced into an unrelated punitive medium.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, imposed immersion in fire answers an earlier chosen immersion in the group's discourse and activity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus verb normally activates fire, not hunting equipment. It remains valid as an overlay because the focus inventory explicitly supplies a set snare and the later scene supplies startled flight from a pursuer. Downstream prose should mark it as a chase-capture image that supplements, never replaces, the literal Saqar fire reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus causative read through the ص ل ي inventory's explicit snare branch.

activation_trace.role: A set trap supplies Saqar's exploratory function as the apparatus that catches the fleeing object.
Recoiling and distancing oneself supplies the startled departure that begins the chase image.
Flight and escape supply the object's attempted motion away from warning.
The pursuing qaswarah supplies the force that turns flight into a chase ending in capture.

changed_reading.before: Saqar is only the place of fire awaiting the condemned object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Saqar is also the snare reached by those whose flight from reminder becomes the very motion of their capture.

strongest_changes: The parallel with the imposed steep ascent and the no-remainder aftermath make the focus an extended, exhaustive heat process rather than a bare transfer.
The direct Saqar question followed by absence from the prayer-doers activates a strong prayer/fire inversion across both mapped roots.
Earning, collateral retention, and insertion create an inspectable path from deeds to capture in Saqar.
The assay and reminder sequence gives the disclosed fire apparatus an epistemic effect on observers as well as a punitive effect on its object.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the two-word threat function as a hinge: earlier futures and greatness language specify its agency, immediate aftermath specifies its material action, and later roots reopen it as assay, ordered path, prayer inversion, social capture, and finally a judgment bounded by protection and forgiveness.
remaining_uncertainties: The fire-straightening and assay mechanisms may be productive material analogies rather than intended lexical entailments.
The prayer/fire inversion is structurally strong but depends on treating the packet's split ص ل ي and ص ل و mappings as an audible root-field relation.
In 74:29 البشر may activate exposed skin or humanity collectively; only the first yields the specifically surface-working model.
The processional follower and hunter-snare readings should remain exploratory overlays, not replacements for the direct fire encounter.
The closing forgiveness boundary limits the scope of the focus threat but does not establish any change in the announced target's outcome.
